Dave

In answer to your question, no; it was meant to represent a cut from the B# to the B. I’m still a bit of a novice with this ABC melarkey and I was worried about the note being shorter which would cause an error and force me to use rests - I’m too lazy at the mo’! By the way, great session yesterday! I wish I hadn’t downed those Duvels before we even got started. See you next week.

Con
